description: Reported issue: fighting with a Lions of the Emperor Custodian Guard squad, the player was wounding on 2+ from Against All Odds but NOTHING on screen said so — the melee resolution panel showed only 'N wound(s) caused' and the Dice Log showed an anonymous 'Wound modifier: +1'. This scenario isolates U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_A mid-board (nearest friendly well beyond 6") with U_BOYZ_K in engagement range, then proves the three new surfaces a player can actually see: (1) the models SPARKLE on the board — deliberately NOT an extra ring, which would make the base size ambiguous; (2) hovering a sparkling model explains the bonus in words and names the nearest friendly with its distance; (3) the FightResolutionDock grows a MODIFIERS section naming 'Against All Odds' at BOTH the hit and wound pauses, and the Dice Log names the source instead of printing a bare +1. Setup-only privileges: CP zeroed so no stratagem prompt interrupts the staged rolls, auto_allocate_wounds on so the defender's save overlay does not block the sequence, Boyz wounds inflated so no model dies mid-scenario and changes the board mid-assert.

steps.script: GameState.state.players["1"].merge({"cp": 0}, true)
GameState.state.players["2"].merge({"cp": 0}, true)
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
main._recreate_unit_visuals()
PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance().enter_phase(GameState.create_snapshot())

# The nearest friendly is measured and named — this is what the hover card
# reports, and it must be beyond 6" for the bonus to be live.
var st = FactionAbilityManager.get_against_all_odds_status("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_A")
return st.get("nearest_name", "") != "" and float(st.get("nearest_inches", 0.0)) > 6.0

var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var focus := Vector2(372.0, 1215.0)
var z := 5.0
var vp: Vector2 = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
m.camera.position = focus
m.camera.zoom = Vector2(z, z)
m.view_zoom = z
m.view_offset = focus - vp / (2.0 * z)
m.update_view_transform()
return true
main.fit_view_to_board()

var t = tree.root.get_node("Main")._token_hover_label
return t != null and t.get_parsed_text().contains("Against All Odds")
main.get_node("FightController").fight_resolution_dock.is_active()
